title: Our family had a great...
text: Our family had a great time on the tour. One of our favorite parts was riding the scooters through the park.

title: So much fun
text: So much fun. Very informative. A great way to see the city. My kids and wife loved it. Our guide was fun and informative but also kept the pace great.
author: Chris_C

title: City bike tour with TOP guide
text: Verruit the best way to explore the city is by bike! And with the expert explanation of guide Ale, this is definitely recommended, even for people who do not feel 100% comfortable on a bike because of the slow pace and the many rest / break moments.
author: GrandTour19655992065

title: Perfect.
text: Perfect! Beautiful tower, very friendly activity to discover the main sites. Many thanks to Alain, our Guide, for his explanations, kindness and availability. Thank you Alain, it was perfect.
author: etchegoyhenf

title: Fun Sevilla Trivia with Children
text: My boys (ages 8 & 12) FINALLY enjoyed city sightseeing!!! Our guide Cody was patient and cool with my boys. He gave interesting facts instead of history lessons that could've bored my boys and me (even though I love history). The kick scooter was easy to maneuver and learned to use it in 5 minutes. We rode around Plaza de España Sevilla for awhile and Cody took beautiful pictures of my family. Definitely recommended for anyone, especially for parents with children.
author: SohaMcClure

title: Codi is the best
text: Cody did a great job. He really made it specific tomorrow needs and didn’t mind to spend some extra time
author: patbeef

title: Fun and Interesting!
text: This was a wonderful tour to do on our first trip to Sevilla!  Cobi was knowledgeable, patient (with kickscooter first-timers!) and fluent in English and Spanish.  He took us all over the city stopping for all the popular tourist attractions as well as sharing with us his personal local favorite restaurants and places to explore.  Definitely do this tour!
author: Linda_N

title: Excellent tour of Seville on the kickscooters!
text:
We spent an amazing afternoon with family! Very funny and super interesting everything that guide Rigo told us, a genius!
Nico attended us super well and gave us many recommendations from Seville.
We will definitely be back tomorrow! To continue touring the city in the kickscooters that are very good!!!
author: mariajoseb77

title: An unforgettable experience
text: Great, great fun. An unforgettable experience. Our expectations have been well met. For their part, those responsible for the business very friendly, professional and attentive. They don’t look at the end time and give you room for any unforeseen events. Fully recommended.

text: Good value for money and fantastic treatment from guillermo and Nico explain everything patiently and adapt the activity to your needs and tastes. Thanks for everything, we'll repeat sure
